bestPerActivity.why: Void Strike is the amp one-shot engine — 777 amp + void-sling headshot one-shots shields.
Raw amp + operator damage for shield phases; Void Strike buffs weapon damage too.
Caustic Strike strips 100% of armor — the only full strip in the game.
Protective Sling gives instant invulnerable revives; Mending Soul cheat-death; Guardian Shell DR.
Power Spike stops combo from fully resetting — combo stays alive between packs.
Affinity Spike boosts affinity gain — faster mastery and focus.
Wellspring is permanent energy regen on demand — the classic solution.
Guardian Shell + Mending Soul + instant self-sustain; slot Unairu's Last Gasp way-bound for the self-revive.
Zenurik first for energy economy; then max way-bounds everywhere. ESO + Eidolon shards are the fastest focus sources.
Unairu for the 100% strip on tanky Archons; Vazarin if your squad needs revives.

focusFarm: Finish The Second Dream to unlock Focus, then The War Within for full operator control. Earn focus with max-rank gear carrying a Lens (Eidolon Lens converts the most). Fastest sources: Eidolon hunts (Brilliant/Radiant shards convert to 25k/40k focus), Elite Sanctuary Onslaught, Zariman bounties, and Sorties. Way-bounds must be maxed, then 'unbound' with 1M focus + a Brilliant Eidolon Shard to work on EVERY school.
note: Way-bounds are the shared passives: max one, unbind it (costs 1M focus + a Brilliant Eidolon Shard), and it works on all five schools. Priority unbinds: Last Gasp (Unairu, self-revive), Void Flow (Zenurik, energy), Mind Step (Naramon, sling speed), Inner Gaze (Madurai, amp energy).

abilities.augment: Void Fuel — +40% weapon efficiency for Operator and Warframe while Void Strike is active.
abilities.effect: Consumes ALL operator energy for a huge damage window: +10% damage for every 1% energy consumed, for 8 seconds. 40s cooldown. The Eidolon one-shot button.
abilities.name: Void Strike

abilities.augment: Distilled Contamination — killing a contaminated enemy makes ALL contaminated enemies 25% more vulnerable and extends the effect. Max 3 stacks.
abilities.effect: Emits a void wave that drenches enemies for 2s, making them 25% more vulnerable to Operator damage for 20s.
abilities.name: Contamination Wave

ampOneShot.arcane: Virtuos Strike (crit chance on the amp). Farm from the Quills (Cetus) or Vox Solaris (Fortuna).
ampOneShot.brace: Certus Brace — crit chance. The crit multiplies the one-shot.
ampOneShot.combo: 1) Pop Void Strike. 2) Void-sling straight UP to the Eidolon's head. 3) Fire the Phahd discs point-blank into the head for the headshot multiplier. Shields pop in one hit.
ampOneShot.note: Older guides mention the Madurai node 'Eternal Eradicate' — it was REMOVED in the Focus 3.0 rework (Angels of the Zariman). Void Strike + Power Transfer is its replacement; the combo above is the current one-shot method.
ampOneShot.prism: Klamora Prism — hitscan beam for precise headshots.
ampOneShot.scaffold: Phahd Scaffold — bouncing discs; the discs double-dip headshot multipliers, which is why the 777 one-shots.

schools.bestFor: Eidolon hunts, amp damage, raw operator DPS
schools.description: The damage school. Solves problems with overwhelming void force — the Eidolon hunter's home.

movement.effect: Consecutive Void Slings cost 50% less energy. Augment Sling Strength: switching to your Warframe after a chained sling grants +40% Ability Strength for 20s.
movement.name: Chained Sling

schools.name: Madurai

passives.effect: +25% Physical damage and Operator damage. Free damage, always on.
passives.name: Phoenix Talons

passives.effect: Transferring to Operator grants +100% Amp Critical Damage for 20s; transferring to Warframe grants +50% Casting Speed. The transfer dance is the Madurai playstyle.
passives.name: Power Transfer

waybounds.effect: +40% energy for Amps and Void Beam. More shots before recharging — the one-shot needs the pool.
waybounds.name: Inner Gaze

waybounds.effect: +60% energy regeneration rate for Amps and Void Beam. Faster recovery between Void Strikes.
waybounds.name: Eternal Gaze

abilities.augment: Guardian Break — releases the stored damage in a blast.
abilities.effect: Wraps you in a damage-reduction shell that stores incoming damage. Your 'oh no' button for Steel Path.
abilities.name: Guardian Shell

abilities.effect: Tethers enemies in place — stops chargers and drags packs together for AoE.
abilities.name: Void Snare

schools.bestFor: Support, reviving in Steel Path, solo survivability
schools.description: The protector school. Keeps the squad alive through content that one-shots everyone else.

movement.effect: Allies you Void Sling through become invulnerable for 5 seconds. Sling THROUGH a downed teammate to revive them instantly and safely.
movement.name: Protective Sling

schools.name: Vazarin

passives.effect: Boosts healing you give and receive — makes every heal land harder.
passives.name: Mending Unity

passives.effect: Grants cheat-death charges: lethal damage is negated instead of downing you. The 'second life' passive.
passives.name: Mending Soul

voidmode.effect: Regenerate health while in Void Mode. Augment Squad Regen: nearby allies regen too — hide the whole squad in the void to heal.
voidmode.name: Void Regen

waybounds.effect: +Health for your Operator. Simple, effective — operator dies less.
waybounds.name: Enduring Tides

waybounds.effect: Health regeneration for your Operator. Passive recovery between fights.
waybounds.name: Rejuvenating Tides

abilities.augment: Lethal Levitation — lifted enemies take bonus damage.
abilities.effect: Lifts enemies into the air, suspending them helplessly.
abilities.name: Void Levitation

abilities.augment: Killer's Rush — bonus finisher damage after the stun.
abilities.effect: Your Void Sling stuns enemies you pass through — CC on the move.
abilities.name: Sling Stun

schools.bestFor: Melee builds, affinity farming, combo weapons
schools.description: The melee school. Keeps your combo counter alive and your XP flowing.

movement.effect: +Void Sling range. Cross the map in fewer slings.
movement.name: Far Sling

schools.name: Naramon

passives.effect: Your melee combo decays instead of fully resetting when the timer expires — combo survives between packs. THE reason melee players live here.
passives.name: Power Spike

passives.effect: Bonus affinity from kills — faster mastery rank, faster focus, faster everything.
passives.name: Affinity Spike

waybounds.effect: Faster Void Sling — you move quicker through missions.
waybounds.name: Mind Step

waybounds.effect: +Void Sling range (also a movement node). More mobility on every school once unbound.
waybounds.name: Far Sling
waybounds.why: Stacks with Mind Step for maximum zoom.

abilities.augment: Magnetic Boost — stronger pull and longer duration.
abilities.effect: Magnetizes enemies, pulling them into a ball — groups packs for AoE.
abilities.name: Magnetic Flare

abilities.augment: Unairu Wisp — Caustic Strike spawns wisps that boost Operator damage.
abilities.effect: Fires a projectile that strips 100% of enemy armor in an area. The ONLY full armor strip in the game — this is why Unairu rules Steel Path.
abilities.name: Caustic Strike

schools.bestFor: Steel Path armor strip, level-cap runs, tanky targets
schools.description: The breaker school. Deletes armor — and with it, the main thing keeping high-level enemies alive.
schools.name: Unairu

passives.effect: Knockdown resistance — you don't get ragdolled mid-fight.
passives.name: Poise

passives.effect: Damage reduction / armor for your Operator — tankier void kid.
passives.name: Stone Skin

waybounds.effect: When downed, kill enemies as your Operator to revive YOURSELF. The most famous way-bound — unbind this first.
waybounds.name: Last Gasp
waybounds.why: #1 unbind priority in the game. Self-revive works everywhere, including Steel Path and Archon hunts.

waybounds.effect: Bonus damage after taking damage — rewards aggressive play.
waybounds.name: Vengeance

abilities.augment: Hardened Wellspring — also grants ability strength in the zone.
abilities.effect: Drops an energy-regen zone at your feet — stand in it for constant energy. The classic fix for energy-hungry frames. Also works on Necramechs.
abilities.name: Wellspring

abilities.augment: Temporal Shot — your amp shots slow enemies.
abilities.effect: Slows enemies in an area — soft CC that makes everything easier to hit.
abilities.name: Temporal Drag

schools.bestFor: Energy-hungry frames, new players, long missions
schools.description: The energy school. The default first school for a reason — it solves energy forever.

movement.effect: Your Void Sling disarms enemies you pass through. Augment No Quarter: also deals damage.
movement.name: Disarming Sling

schools.name: Zenurik

passives.effect: Energy regeneration / efficiency for your Operator — more slings, more abilities.
passives.name: Energy Pulse

passives.effect: Your next Warframe ability costs no energy or shields — recharges every 60s. Free ult once a minute.
passives.name: Inner Might

waybounds.effect: Regenerate energy while in Void Mode — duck into the void to refill.
waybounds.name: Void Siphon

waybounds.effect: +Operator energy pool. More energy = more slings, more Void Strikes, more everything.
waybounds.name: Void Flow
waybounds.why: Top-tier unbind — energy is the operator's lifeblood.

unlock: Complete The Second Dream (unlocks Focus), then The War Within (unlocks full Operator control). Pick a school at the end of The Second Dream — Zenurik is the recommended first pick for energy, Madurai if you're rushing Eidolons.
